campaignDetail.rawSolrQuery: (type:CITY OR (df_str_hotel_codes:rh-* AND type:HOTEL_META_INFO)) AND -((title:*apart* OR title:*host* OR title:*flat* OR title:*casa*))
campaignDetail.title: Hotels

rateConditions:
• Hotels may charge a security deposit at the time of check in, which will be refundable if unutilized.
  • Check in & Check out time is for information purposes and may change without intimation.
  • Early Check in and Late check out are subject to availability and as per Hotel Policy.
  • Carrying valid ID proof and Voucher copy is recommended.
  • Any Supplementary charges / Gala Dinner / City Tax etc. to be paid directly at the property.
  • Bedding type is subject to availability at the time of check in.
  • Extra beds are not included in the reservation price unless stated in the hotel / booking policies.
  • Hotels may not allow any additional passenger apart from those reflecting in the booking.
  • Special Requests are subject to availability and cannot be pre confirmed / guaranteed.
  • Hotels may deny check in or charge a different amount if the nationality is different than mentioned at the time of reservation.
  • To avail any complementary service, guests need to contact the hotel directly. Hotel reserves the rights to accept, deny or withdraw the same.

detail.description: This hotel is centrally located in the Eastern suburb of Mumbai. Guests will find themselves within easy driving distance of the airport, as well as the main business districts of the Bandra Kurla Complex and the JNPT area. This charming hotel is situated in close proximity to the main attractions that the area has to offer. This charming hotel boasts a striking architectural style, designed by the famous architects Somaya and Kallappa. This luxurious hotel comprises sumptuously-appointed guest rooms, which provide a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to completely unwind. Guests will be impressed by the first-class facilities that this stunning hotel has to offer, and are assured of a truly memorable stay.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data: This hotel is centrally located in the Eastern suburb of Mumbai. Guests will find themselves within easy driving distance of the airport, as well as the main business districts of the Bandra Kurla Complex and the JNPT area. This charming hotel is situated in close proximity to the main attractions that the area has to offer. This charming hotel boasts a striking architectural style, designed by the famous architects Somaya and Kallappa. This luxurious hotel comprises sumptuously-appointed guest rooms, which provide a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to completely unwind. Guests will be impressed by the first-class facilities that this stunning hotel has to offer, and are assured of a truly memorable stay.

hotelDetailMap.title: Rules and Policies
data:
• Hotels may charge a security deposit at the time of check in, which will be refundable if unutilized.
  • Check in & Check out time is for information purposes and may change without intimation.
  • Early Check in and Late check out are subject to availability and as per Hotel Policy.
  • Carrying valid ID proof and Voucher copy is recommended.
  • Any Supplementary charges / Gala Dinner / City Tax etc. to be paid directly at the property.
  • Bedding type is subject to availability at the time of check in.
  • Extra beds are not included in the reservation price unless stated in the hotel / booking policies.
  • Hotels may not allow any additional passenger apart from those reflecting in the booking.
  • Special Requests are subject to availability and cannot be pre confirmed / guaranteed.
  • Hotels may deny check in or charge a different amount if the nationality is different than mentioned at the time of reservation.
  • To avail any complementary service, guests need to contact the hotel directly. Hotel reserves the rights to accept, deny or withdraw the same.

• Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • This property accepts credit cards, debit cards, and cash
  • Safety features at this property include a fire extinguisher, a smoke detector, a security system, and a first aid kit
  • Please note that cultural norms and guest policies may differ by country and by property; the policies listed are provided by the property

This property offers transfers from the airport (surcharges may apply). Guests must contact the property with arrival details before travel, using the contact information on the booking confirmation. Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival at the property. Information provided by the property may be translated using automated translation tools. To register at this property, guests who are Indian citizens must provide a valid photo identity card issued by the Government of India; travelers who are not citizens of India must present a valid passport and visa.

• The property has connecting/adjoining rooms, which are subject to availability and can be requested by contacting the property using the number on the booking confirmation.
  • Contactless check-in and contactless check-out are available.

• Fee for buffet breakfast: approximately INR 350 per person
  • Airport shuttle fee: INR 2000 per vehicle (one-way, maximum occupancy 3)

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.
